newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill cuts Merck, raises Warner.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill cuts Merck, raises Warner.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said it downgraded its near-, and long-term ratings on Merck and Co Inc to accumulate from buy and upgraded its Warner-Lambert Co near- and long-term ratings buy from accumulate.

-- Analyst Stephen Buermann said the ratings changes were based on a survey of physicians that showed Warner-Lambert's recently introduced Lipitor cholesterol-lowering drug would have a stronger-than-anticipated launch. The drug competes with Merck's Mevacor and Zocor.
-- Pfizer Inc is Warner-Lambert's marketing partner for Lipitor.
-- Merrill raised its 1997 earnings per share estimate on Warner-Lambert to $3.20 from $3.15 and boosted 1998 to $4.10 from $3.80.
-- The firm maintianed its 1997 earnings estimate on Merck at $3.85 but cut 1998 to $4.45 from $4.55.
